2.0.0: Change ListTables parameters from properties to inputs.
2.1.5: Fix output type file on ListTables.
2.1.6: Fix occasionally using wrong project ID.
3.0.0: (breaking) ListProjects: updated endpoint to retrieve project properties. The object returned is not backward compatible.
4.0.1: (breaking) Added Projects list in the input properties of NewRow, UpdatedRow, DeletedRow to fix error of projectId not found.
Removed the need to select Storage in NewRow, UpdatedRow and DeletedRow Triggers. Removed the toggle for recordOldValues in UpdatedRow Trigger.
4.0.2: UpdatedRow: declare detectOnStop in properties.schema.properties so the inspector input reaches the trigger.
4.1.0: NewRow, UpdatedRow: added test() method for Flow Test Mode (read-only fetch of the newest matching row). DeletedRow has no read-only example source and is intentionally not testable this way.
4.2.0: Added MakeApiCall component for performing arbitrary authorized API calls to the Google BigQuery API.
4.2.1: Fixed a crash when a Find/List component saved an EMPTY result set to a CSV file — the header row was built from the first record without checking there was one, so a search that legitimately matched nothing failed the flow instead of writing an empty file.
4.2.2: Added an output schema with an example to AddRow.
4.2.3: NewRow and DeletedRow: the project picker is now a typeahead text field, so a value can still be entered when the list fails to load; added output schemas with examples.
